text: Long catch-up with Mohammed. His dad passed away on Sunday, funeral is Friday 6 November at the mosque on Clarence Rd. He sounded exhausted but said his sister Adaeze is handling most of it. Need to send flowers to his mum before then.

Pedro's finally moving to Lisbon, flight's booked for 14 January 2027. He's still looking at flats in Alfama and has two viewings lined up over FaceTime. Chloe's going out with him for the first week. He's selling most of his furniture, so if anyone wants a decent desk let him know. His mum is not thrilled about him leaving but she's planning to visit at Easter.

Coffee with Ann and Stefan. Ann's knitting a whole blanket for the new grandbaby, she's on square 40 of 64. Stefan's back into chess, plays online every night and is going to a tournament in Leeds on 28/11. Ann reckons he's spending more on chess books than food. Should ask Stefan how Leeds went, he's aiming for a rating of 1800 by summer.
Alina and her boyfriend split up last weekend after four years. She's staying at her brother Theo's for now. Remind me to check in with her on Thursday, she said evenings are the worst.

Leah got made redundant, last day is 30th of November. She's weirdly upbeat about it, says she might finally do the pottery course she's always talked about. Her husband is less relaxed apparently. They've got the mortgage to think about and their son starts uni in September 2027. Leah wants to have a proper chat over wine soon, maybe the week after she finishes. I said I'd host.
Wiremu rang. Massive All Blacks fan, already planning to watch the test on 15 Nov at the pub with his cousins. He wants a signed shirt for his 40th, that's 3 Feb, worth remembering.
Viewing at 2pm Saturday for the flat on Ashford St. Bring bank statements and the reference letter.
Joseph's mum's funeral was yesterday. Lots of people came. He said his kids handled it better than he did. Should text him at the weekend just to see how he's doing.

Aarav is obsessed with Warhammer at the moment, painting a full Space Marines army. His wife Kavya says the dining table is no longer theirs lol. He's entering a painting comp in Nottingham in March 2027.
Bumped into Keisha at Tesco. Her and Elijah have exchanged on the house in Bristol!! Moving day is 12 December. She's nervous about the kids changing schools in January.
Astrid's dog Biscuit had his op today, they removed a lump from his leg. Results back in about ten days. She's beside herself. Don't forget to ask her on the 2nd how the biopsy came back.
Call w Matilda. Her and Phoebe broke up, Phoebe's moved out already. Matilda's keeping the flat and the cat. Said she's okay, mostly, just tired. Thinking of getting back into climbing to keep busy.
Theo's band is playing the Lexington on 21/11, first proper London gig. He's bricking it. Bought two tickets, I'm taking Aidan.
Oliver's grandad died on the 9th. Funeral got moved, now 19 October was it? no, 19 November. He asked if I could do a reading. Need to tell him yes and ask which poem.

Kaito moved to Manchester last month, loves it but hasn't made friends yet. Plays in a five a side league Tuesdays. Big City fan which helps. Says the rent is half what he paid in London. His girlfriend Jada is joining him in the new year once her contract ends on 31 December. He's already scoping out gigs at the Albert Hall for them.
Adaeze has been crocheting amigurumi for a craft fair on Saturday 7 Nov, she's made like 80 tiny frogs. Buy one or two as stocking fillers, she'd love that.
Björn told me his engagement to Lin is off. They're still living together till the lease ends in April 2027 which sounds grim. He seemed flat but said he's fine. Lin's going back to Taipei after.
Francesca is reading her way through every Booker winner, she's on 1990s now. Hates Ian McEwan with a passion though. Book token for Christmas would go down well.
Dana's company is closing the Glasgow office, everyone's at risk. Consultation meeting is 4 December. She's really anxious, the mortgage just went up too. Ring her the evening after.
Teresa and her husband are house hunting in Bath. Seen eleven places, hated ten. Second viewing on the one with the garden next Wednesday, offer probably by end of month.
Must pick up the boxes from Kavya's before Sunday. Packing starts 1st of December.

Yusuf's brother Dawit lost his job at the warehouse, the redundancy came out of nowhere. Yusuf's helping him with his CV. Dawit has an interview on the 18th at the council and is stressed about it. Remind me to message Yusuf on the 18th to wish Dawit luck.
Jada's mad into Formula 1 now, knows every driver's tyre strategy. Going to the Abu Dhabi race 6-8 December with her dad, his 60th present. She's never been to a race before.

Elijah said his nan died peacefully in her sleep on Tuesday. They were really close, she basically raised him. Funeral is Monday 26th of October in Cork. He's flying out with Keisha on the Saturday. Need to send a card to his mum's address, he'll text it to me. Also offered to feed their cat Pepper while they're away, so I need the spare key before Friday.
Kiara got the flat in Leith!! Moving in on 15/12, can't believe it. Her mum is driving up from Leicester with a van. She wants plant cuttings for the windowsill as a housewarming thing.
Lunch with Mohammed and Pedro. Mohammed's got season tickets for Villa this year and goes to every home game with his son. Pedro's learning the guitar, three months in, can play Wonderwall badly.
Ann's husband passed in 2019 and she's still in the same house. She mentioned she might downsize next year, maybe a bungalow near her daughter in Exeter. Nothing decided.
Need to cancel the gym membership before 1 November and book the removal van.
Stefan's daughter Alina is starting uni in Prague in September 2027, she's been learning Czech on Duolingo. Stefan's nervous about her being so far away.
Wiremu and his partner had their housewarming cancelled, the boiler packed in the day before. They're redoing it on 5/12 instead. I'm bringing a lasagne.
Leah's reading group is doing Middlemarch over winter, she's roped in Phoebe and Chloe. Meeting first Thursday of each month. Leah wants me to join, I'll think about it.
Joseph says his band are recording an EP in January, three songs. Their drummer Aidan quit, so they're auditioning drummers on the 10th and 17th. Should ask him who they picked.
Spoke to Keisha. Her mum's had a stroke, she's in the Royal Infirmary. Keisha's going up to Newcastle tomorrow and staying at least a week. Don't forget to text her Friday to see how her mum's doing.
Aarav's had a rough few weeks, he and Lin broke up on 2 October and he's had to move back in with his parents in Slough. He's playing a lot of FIFA. Says he's alright but doesn't sound it.
Theo and Matilda viewed a two bed in Walthamstow, really liked it. Offer in at £385k, hearing back by Monday. Theo's already measured for the sofa.
Astrid is training for the Berlin marathon, 21 September 2027. Running 50k a week already. Her husband Oliver Novak thinks she's mad.
Kaito invited me to his ceramics class showcase on 3rd of December. He's made a full tea set. Remind me to put it in the calendar.
Remember: bins Tuesday, dentist 14/11 9:30, renew passport before March 2027.

Long chat with Björn after footy. His mum is moving into a care home on 10 December, he's sorting her house on his own, his brother Stefan's no help. Björn is struggling, barely sleeping. He collects vinyl, mostly 70s Krautrock, and said he might sell some to pay for the care home. Need to call him next week and offer to help clear the loft.
Francesca's sister Teresa got married in Florence on 3 October, the photos are unreal. Francesca gave a speech in Italian and English. She's now planning her own move to Milan in summer 2027.
Phoebe's thinking of leaving Leeds for Glasgow, says the music scene is better. Already been up twice to look at flats in the West End. Her lease ends 31/01.
Dana got a new puppy, a sausage dog called Waffle. Puppy classes start Saturday 14 November. She's already bought it four jumpers.
Pedro's dad Mr Costa is retiring on 18 December after thirty years at the post office. There's a do at the Red Lion on the 19th. Pedro asked if I'd chip in for a watch. Remind me to send him £20.
Lin wants to get into bouldering, asked if I'd go with her. Also she's started a sourdough starter called Gerald.
Teresa said her boss is being awful since the restructure. She's applying elsewhere, has an interview at the BBC on 23 November. Must remember to text her good luck the night before.
Yusuf's grandmother's funeral was on 30 September, I couldn't make it. He seemed okay today. Talked mostly about Arsenal.
Moving date confirmed: 7 January 2027. Landlord does the walkthrough on the 6th. Sort a cleaner.
Dawit runs a little Ethiopian supper club once a month in his flat, next one is 12/11. He cooks everything himself, doro wat is the speciality. He's vegetarian himself funnily enough.

Jada and Kiara are flat hunting together in Brighton. They've seen one place they loved but the landlord won't take pets and Kiara's got a cat called Mochi. Viewing two more on 9th of Nov. Jada's the one doing all the spreadsheets, Kiara just wants a bath. Their deadline is the end of November because Jada's current lease runs out on 1/12. I said I'd lend them my car for the move.
Elijah's partner Chloe is training to be a doula, finishes the course in May 2027. Elijah's doing a sea swim every morning, says it's saved his sanity since the redundancy in August.

Caught up with Kiara, Aidan and Adaeze at the pub. Aidan's become a proper birdwatcher, he's got a scope and everything and spotted a hen harrier last week. Adaeze is moving to Edinburgh on 20th of January for a new job at the uni and is excited but nervous about not knowing anyone. Kiara's got her brother's wedding on 12 December and she's doing the cake herself, three tiers. Should send Adaeze some names of people I know up there.
Oliver says he's quit the darts league, too much drinking. Still plays at home. His wife Ann bought him a new board for his birthday.
Stefan's kids, Leah and Joseph, are both doing Duke of Edinburgh gold this year. Expedition is in the Brecon Beacons in April 2027.

Matilda's grandad Uncle Pete, everyone calls him Uncle P, died last Thursday. Funeral is 2 November 2026 at St Mary's. Matilda's doing the eulogy and is dreading it. Remind me to ring her that evening.
Note to self: look at flats in Hackney and Leyton this weekend, budget £1600. Ask about parking.
Aidan's into Dungeons & Dragons now, runs a campaign every other Sunday. He's been DM-ing for two years. Wants a set of metal dice, the fancy ones.

Alina said her dad Stefan Walsh got made redundant from the bank on Friday. He's putting a brave face on it but she thinks he's gutted. He's got a leaving lunch on 13/11. Should send him a message next week, nothing heavy.

Ann and her husband Wiremu are celebrating 25 years on the 3rd of December, small dinner at home. Their daughter Kavya is flying back from Sydney for it. Ann wants to surprise him with a framed photo of their wedding day in 2001, she asked if I could help find a good framer. Wiremu has no idea. Remind me to send her the name of that place on the high street.
Kavya mentioned she's fed up with London and wants to move somewhere with hills. Keeps talking about Sheffield.
Quick one. Mohammed's son Yusuf passed his driving test this morning, fourth go. Mohammed's thrilled. Also Mohammed's knee is still bad, physio twice a week.
